text: Implemented the frozen nonnegative canonical-root v1 estimand in ScalaFIM commit a9d2850, backed by Gale projected-Rayleigh commit 2d9c854 (pushed on origin/codex/constrained-rayleigh). The typed problem lowers GeneralizedRayleigh, residual normalization, and NonnegativeOrthant ConstraintTerm through OperatorProgram; the MVPA adapter uses runwise sufficient statistics, frozen pre-fold settings, held-out-first-after-fit access, ordinary MvpaResult/streaming, and stationary-point diagnostics. Independent base-R active-face fixtures reproduce all directions, roots, ridges, and held-out scores. Focused multivar and mvpa-fit suites pass on JVM and Scala.js; full sbt compileAll testAll passes.
